Rider advocate8 claim(s), 7 kept

  1. The charge stands or falls on POL-NS-01, and that clause is conjunctive: the platform must carry every one of limbs (a) to (d), including limb (c), a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force.

    Read the whole claim

    Trip_record.platform_policy fixes that period for this BUTTON-marker trip at free_wait_sec = 180 seconds, and no_show_threshold_sec is null, so nothing lengthens it. The driver's own derived trace measures the longest continuous in-geofence run at 143 seconds against that 180 second minimum - a 37 second shortfall (derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.longest_run_sec, .shortfall_sec, .shortfall_basis = longest_run_sec). Limb (c) therefore fails, and the fee is not chargeable. The run is short on any reading of the minimum: 143 seconds also falls well short of the 300 second figure fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec retains for records authored before policy version 2. Disclosure: EV-GPS-02756 is impaired - weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE - and the shortfall figure rests on the fixes that were in fact recorded; the impairment helps the rider, not the platform, as claim 4 explains.

    EV-GPS-02756, EV-TRIP-02756 · POL-NS-01

  2. Once the effective in-geofence dwell falls short, POL-NS-06 is strict liability and the arithmetic is complete: the cancellation fee 'is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and no driver compensation is payable.

    Read the whole claim

    The shortfall is 37 seconds against the 180 second minimum. The sum to refund is the cancellation-fee line actually charged: EV-FARE-02756 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0, and that 4.50 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (the net figure), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to complicate the remedy - the rider's contested 4.50 is refunded in full. Disclosure as to the trace the figure comes from: EV-GPS-02756 is impaired, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

    EV-FARE-02756, EV-GPS-02756, EV-TRIP-02756 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

  3. The only route by which the platform can reach 180 seconds is to add separate in-geofence intervals together, or to credit the 400 second span that bridges them as one continuous run.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-06(i) forbids both. Summing is permitted only where the trace shows the driver never travelled more than 300 m from the pin AND a present, populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting window. EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING - no payload, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - so limb (i) is unavailable, and the derived accumulation block itself records both disqualifying conditions (excursion_unmeasurable and advisory_missing). It follows that the two intervals of 60 and 143 seconds cannot be summed to 203, and the 197 second sampling gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 cannot be scored as waiting time. The effective dwell remains the 143 seconds the derivation reports, and the gap-based 400 second run is not available to the platform. Disclosure: EV-GPS-02756 is impaired, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE; the absence of the advisory is a zero-weight artifact whose absence is itself citable.

    EV-ADVIS-02756-01, EV-GPS-02756 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

  4. The 197 second sampling gap in EV-GPS-02756 sits inside the waiting window (11:33:47 to 11:37:04) and exceeds the 120 second threshold in POL-NS-08(b), so the artifact is impaired at policy level as well as the 0.39 applied by the pre-pass.

    Read the whole claim

    That impairment cannot be used to fill the driver's clock: under POL-GEN-02(2) a claim resting on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08 cannot alone support a ruling against the party it disfavours, and the only party who needs the gap treated as served waiting time is the driver, whose own statement is that he waited the full time. Nothing on the rider's side depends on the hole in the trace: the 143 second ceiling is measured from recorded fixes, and POL-NS-06(i) independently refuses to bridge the gap. Disclosure: EV-GPS-02756 impaired, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

    EV-GPS-02756 · POL-NS-08, POL-GEN-02

  5. The rider's own conduct does not enter the shortfall analysis at all.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded, so the empty chat log (EV-CHAT-02756: message_count 0, admissibility COMPLETE, weight 1.0) and the absent rider track (derived.rider_presence.available false, 'the source trace carries no rider track') decide nothing against the rider. POL-NS-11 says the same in terms: a missing rider_track is not the evidence for any deciding fact under the remaining clauses, a rider who cannot be traced is not thereby a rider who was elsewhere, and the judge must say the presence test could not be run rather than reading absence as fault. This claim is made only as to the shortfall route under POL-NS-06; the rider makes no claim under POL-NS-04, which cannot run on a chat log with no messages.

Draft 1 - sampled
To the rider and to the driver: the $4.50 charged is real (EV-FARE-02756: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, matching trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), but neither side can presently establish the fact the fee depends on, so the fee is held rather than collected or refunded. The case turns on POL-NS-01 limb (c): a continuous dwell inside the pickup geofence of at least the free waiting period in force, 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180; no_show_threshold_sec null). Arrival itself is not the difficulty: the POL-NS-02 geofence test is met on the fixes the trace does carry - STANDARD zone radius 50 m, 22 qualifying in-radius fixes, the first at 11:32:47, the same moment as the 'arrived' event - and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (nothing places the driver beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at that timestamp), so no false-arrival referral arises. The difficulty is the dwell, and the only artifact that measures it - EV-GPS-02756 - is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and impaired at policy level too under POL-NS-08(b), because its 197-second sampling gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 lies inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second threshold. That gap falls exactly across the stretch that decides limb (c). The admitted in-geofence runs are 60 seconds (11:32:47-11:33:47) and 143 seconds (11:37:04-11:39:27); the longest uninterrupted run is 143 seconds, 37 seconds short of 180. Whether the driver held the geofence throughout the gap - which would make one continuous 400-second dwell and support the fee and a $3.60 payout (80 percent of $4.50) - or left and re-entered - leaving 143 seconds and giving the rider the full $4.50 back under POL-NS-06 - is precisely what the trace does not show. The limb is therefore undecided over the impaired stretch, and an undecided limb supports neither the charge nor the refund. I do not accept either way around that. First, the driver's 400-second run and trip_record.wait_time_min 6.7 do not independently establish the dwell: POL-NS-01(c) measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, and this trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 - which makes the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace - does not apply. The trip record therefore does not carry the dwell fact, the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 0.39, not the maximum of 0.39 and 1.0, and the $3.60 compensation cannot be ordered. The driver's statement that he waited the full time is evidence, but it carries no weight_multiplier and no clause of this category makes a counterparty statement the test for limb (c). Second, the 60-second and 143-second intervals cannot be summed: POL-NS-06(i) permits summing only where a present, populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road, and EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). So 203 seconds cannot be assembled, the 197-second gap cannot be scored as waiting time, and the rider's 143-second shortfall cannot be treated as a decided fact either - it is the reading the trace gives once the gap is refused, but the gap is exactly what could make the dwell sufficient. Other points, briefly. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log holds 0 messages, so limb (a) fails (EV-CHAT-02756). The absent rider track leaves limb (c) of POL-NS-04 undecidable and neutral under POL-NS-11, and does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell evidence. The fare line reconciles (4.50 equals 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean (no_show_terminations_30d 0 against 85 completed trips in 30 days), and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire (both paired-dispute counters 0; no_show_disputes_30d 0). The driver's prior_no_show_flags of 2 is a lifetime counter and context only; it is not a ground of decision and I have not used it. Why the case escalates. The sole evidence for the deciding fact - the in-geofence dwell - is the impaired trace, so POL-NS-08's closing sentence is engaged and POL-NS-09(e) applies; and because the ruling rests on an artifact at 0.39, the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) applies as well. Escalation is terminal: no refund and no compensation issue, and the $4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded. The monetary effect is nil; the sums in play, $4.50 and $3.60, are each below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00. Referrals: none - POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-07's packet instruction are the only candidates on these facts and neither fires. The open question for the human reviewer: on the platform's full-resolution record for TRP-02756, did the driver remain inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius throughout 11:33:47-11:37:04 (a 400-second continuous dwell, which supports the $4.50 fee and a $3.60 driver payout), or did he leave the radius and re-enter (leaving 143 seconds as the longest run and entitling the rider to a full $4.50 refund under POL-NS-06)?
Draft 2 - sampled
To both parties: this dispute over the SGD 4.50 no-show fee goes to a human reviewer, because the one fact the fee turns on cannot be decided on this record. Escalation (POL-NS-09) is terminal: I issue no refund and no compensation, and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held - neither collected from the rider nor refunded to him - while the review is pending. What is settled. The driver accepted the trip at 11:28:17, tapped 'arrived' at 11:32:47 and cancelled at 11:39:28 under the code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a limb (d) code of POL-NS-01. The rider never boarded and the chat log holds 0 messages, so POL-NS-04 cannot run (its limb (a) needs a rider message and there is none); POL-NS-11 says the absent rider track is neutral and decides nothing, and I did not treat it as fault. The fare line of SGD 4.50 equals the SGD 4.50 in force, so there is no fare-integrity defect (POL-NS-08(d)). POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the arrival tap fired at the very first in-geofence fix, 11:32:47 (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so no false-arrival referral is issued. The anti-farming check does not trip (0 no-show terminations against 85 completed trips in 30 days), and nothing in either party's history escalates this (0 and 0 repeat pairings; 0 rider no-show disputes in 30 days). The undecided fact. Whether the driver held position inside the 50 m pickup radius for a continuous 180 seconds (POL-NS-01(c)). That rests on EV-GPS-02756, and I say both things about it, as POL-GEN-02 requires: at the pre-pass level it is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.39 for issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and at policy level it is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), because it contains a 197-second sampling gap (11:33:47 to 11:37:04) inside the waiting window, longer than the 120-second threshold. The impaired stretch is the pivot. On the recorded fixes the driver's longest uninterrupted in-geofence run is 143 seconds - 37 seconds short of the 180-second minimum - and the 60-second and 143-second intervals cannot be added together, because POL-NS-06(i) permits summation only with a present and populated traffic advisory and EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, carrying no fact for anyone). But the 197-second hole is exactly the stretch that could contain the missing 37 seconds, and the trace shows nothing there. The 0.0 km straight-line separation across the gap is a lower bound, not proof the driver stayed inside the radius, and the derived block's own 400-second 'longest qualifying run' is a span across that hole, not a measured continuous dwell. So the driver's account ('I waited the full time') and the trip record's 6.7-minute wait timer do not fill the hole: the wait timer runs from the driver's own arrival tap, whereas POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap, and POL-NS-12 makes the platform's own events an independent carrier only where the arrival marker is GPS_AUTO - this trip's marker is BUTTON. The trip record therefore neither lifts the confidence cap nor stops the impaired trace from being the only evidence of the dwell. The rider's 143-second shortfall finding fails for the same reason: it rests solely on the same impaired artifact and cannot be affirmed while the gap is unobserved. Neither side's reading therefore supports a money ruling. Triggers. POL-NS-09(e): the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(b). POL-NS-09(a): my confidence is capped at 0.39 by the only artifact carrying the deciding fact, below the 0.70 floor. Open question for the reviewer. Did the driver hold position inside the 50 m radius continuously for at least 180 seconds during 11:33:47 to 11:37:04? The rider's 37-second shortfall and the driver's 400-second run cannot both be right, and only a full-resolution GPS export (or the platform's own GPS_AUTO arrival and wait-timer records) can settle it. If the continuous dwell reached 180 seconds, the fee stands and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60. If it did not, POL-NS-06 refunds the SGD 4.50 in full with no compensation. No referral is issued: no clause on these facts produces one.
Draft 3 - sampled
Both of you filed on trip TRP-02756, and neither of you gets a money ruling today. The case goes to a human reviewer, and the $4.50 stays where it is - charged, not refunded, not released to the driver - until that reviewer decides. Here is why, and what each of you should know. WHAT IS SETTLED. The driver accepted at 11:28:17, pressed the arrival marker at 11:32:47, and cancelled at 11:39:28 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW (EV-TRIP-02756, weight 1.0). Nobody boarded. The chat log holds 0 messages and the trip carries no in-app calls (EV-CHAT-02756, weight 1.0). The fare ledger charges $4.50, which equals the cancellation fee in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = $4.50), so there is no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d). There is no traffic advisory covering this pickup: EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. THE QUESTION THAT DECIDES THE $4.50 is whether the driver held position inside the 50 m arrival radius for a continuous 180 seconds - the free waiting period in force, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 (POL-NS-01(c)). The 300 s figure in fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec applies only to records authored before policy version 2 and does not apply to this record, which carries its own platform_policy. On that question the record will not let me rule. THE GAP, AND THE DRIVER'S CASE. EV-GPS-02756 has a 197-second sampling hole from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04, squarely inside the waiting window. That is longer than the 120-second threshold in POL-NS-08(b), so the trace is impaired at policy level, not merely flagged by the pre-pass: its weight is 0.39, from the issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (0.6 x 0.65). You are right, driver, that the trace shows 22 qualifying in-radius fixes, 203 seconds of observed in-radius time in two runs of 60 s and 143 s, and that no fix shows a departure - the straight-line displacement across the hole is 0.0 km and the maximum excursion is unmeasurable. But the same hole is the middle of your 400-second span from 11:32:47 to 11:39:27: the continuity of limb (c) cannot be read across it, so the 400 s run cannot be certified any more than the 143 s run can be certified as the whole dwell. Your claim that EV-TRIP-02756 is an independent second carrier fails the removal test: take the trace away and nothing in the trip record shows the driver inside the geofence - its wait timer runs from a BUTTON tap, and POL-NS-12 makes platform arrival and wait-timer events an independent carrier only for a GPS_AUTO arrival carrying those events in trip_record.events, which this record does not (events is null). POL-NS-01(c) deliberately measures the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap. Your statement that you waited the full time is noted but POL-NS-01(c) does not read a party statement. So the confidence cap is 0.39, not 1.0, and the $3.60 you claim under POL-NS-07 (0.8 x $4.50 = $3.60, arithmetic correct, anti-farming check not tripped: no_show_terminations_30d 0 against 85 completed trips in 30 days) is not paid on this ruling while chargeability itself is undecided. The alternative you offered - escalation on the 143 s reading - is the outcome, but for the reason below rather than the one you gave. THE RIDER'S CASE. Your 143 seconds and your 37-second shortfall are a real reading of the same trace, and you are right that POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: the advisory is MISSING and the derivation itself records advisory_missing and excursion_unmeasurable, so the two runs of 60 s and 143 s cannot be summed to 203 s and the 197 s hole cannot be scored as served waiting time. But this cuts both ways. The same trace cannot show that the driver left and re-entered either, so 143 s cannot be certified as the effective dwell any more than 400 s can. Limb (c) is undecided over the hole, not failed, and an undecided limb supports neither a charge that needs the clause to hold nor a refund that needs it to fail. Your full refund of $4.50 therefore cannot issue on this record, and neither can the charge be confirmed. WHAT YOUR OTHER CLAIMS SETTLED. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails on an empty chat log, so the answered-message route is not reached (accepted, and it does not change the outcome). POL-NS-11: the absent rider track is neutral, it does not impair the driver's arrival and dwell evidence and it is not what sends this case to review (accepted). POL-NS-05 does not fire - the arrival marker coincides with the first qualifying in-radius fix at 11:32:47, offset 0.0 s, so there is no false-arrival finding and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral. No profile field drives this case: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-NS-09(d) does not read and that I have not used - it is context only under POL-GEN-01. WHY ESCALATE. Both sides' dwell claims rest on the same artifact, and that artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(b). Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped by the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact - 0.39, with no independent second carrier - which is below the 0.70 floor, so the case escalates automatically under POL-NS-09(a); and independently, POL-NS-09(e) escalates because the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired. The judge's explanation, verbatim

To the rider and to the driver: the $4.50 charged is real (EV-FARE-02756: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, matching trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), but neither side can presently establish the fact the fee depends on, so the fee is held rather than collected or refunded. The case turns on POL-NS-01 limb (c): a continuous dwell inside the pickup geofence of at least the free waiting period in force, 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180; no_show_threshold_sec null). Arrival itself is not the difficulty: the POL-NS-02 geofence test is met on the fixes the trace does carry - STANDARD zone radius 50 m, 22 qualifying in-radius fixes, the first at 11:32:47, the same moment as the 'arrived' event - and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (nothing places the driver beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at that timestamp), so no false-arrival referral arises. The difficulty is the dwell, and the only artifact that measures it - EV-GPS-02756 - is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and impaired at policy level too under POL-NS-08(b), because its 197-second sampling gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 lies inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second threshold. That gap falls exactly across the stretch that decides limb (c). The admitted in-geofence runs are 60 seconds (11:32:47-11:33:47) and 143 seconds (11:37:04-11:39:27); the longest uninterrupted run is 143 seconds, 37 seconds short of 180. Whether the driver held the geofence throughout the gap - which would make one continuous 400-second dwell and support the fee and a $3.60 payout (80 percent of $4.50) - or left and re-entered - leaving 143 seconds and giving the rider the full $4.50 back under POL-NS-06 - is precisely what the trace does not show. The limb is therefore undecided over the impaired stretch, and an undecided limb supports neither the charge nor the refund. I do not accept either way around that. First, the driver's 400-second run and trip_record.wait_time_min 6.7 do not independently establish the dwell: POL-NS-01(c) measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, and this trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 - which makes the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace - does not apply. The trip record therefore does not carry the dwell fact, the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 0.39, not the maximum of 0.39 and 1.0, and the $3.60 compensation cannot be ordered. The driver's statement that he waited the full time is evidence, but it carries no weight_multiplier and no clause of this category makes a counterparty statement the test for limb (c). Second, the 60-second and 143-second intervals cannot be summed: POL-NS-06(i) permits summing only where a present, populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road, and EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). So 203 seconds cannot be assembled, the 197-second gap cannot be scored as waiting time, and the rider's 143-second shortfall cannot be treated as a decided fact either - it is the reading the trace gives once the gap is refused, but the gap is exactly what could make the dwell sufficient. Other points, briefly. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log holds 0 messages, so limb (a) fails (EV-CHAT-02756). The absent rider track leaves limb (c) of POL-NS-04 undecidable and neutral under POL-NS-11, and does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell evidence. The fare line reconciles (4.50 equals 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean (no_show_terminations_30d 0 against 85 completed trips in 30 days), and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire (both paired-dispute counters 0; no_show_disputes_30d 0). The driver's prior_no_show_flags of 2 is a lifetime counter and context only; it is not a ground of decision and I have not used it. Why the case escalates. The sole evidence for the deciding fact - the in-geofence dwell - is the impaired trace, so POL-NS-08's closing sentence is engaged and POL-NS-09(e) applies; and because the ruling rests on an artifact at 0.39, the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) applies as well. Escalation is terminal: no refund and no compensation issue, and the $4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded. The monetary effect is nil; the sums in play, $4.50 and $3.60, are each below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00. Referrals: none - POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-07's packet instruction are the only candidates on these facts and neither fires. The open question for the human reviewer: on the platform's full-resolution record for TRP-02756, did the driver remain inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius throughout 11:33:47-11:37:04 (a 400-second continuous dwell, which supports the $4.50 fee and a $3.60 driver payout), or did he leave the radius and re-enter (leaving 143 seconds as the longest run and entitling the rider to a full $4.50 refund under POL-NS-06)? The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
